g.text: and errors. Resizing the terminal mid-test must re-wrap the passage and keep the
progress. If it is not started in a terminal, it prints a clear message and exits.
Keep the typing logic (passage generation, keystroke handling, scoring) separate from
the terminal drawing, and cover it with automated tests that run with one command. Write
a README with how to run it, the options and the keys.
Something new · a spec first, one worker, at its strongest setting, with a reviewer
The work added checks, which now gate it: test
changes asked · Stillkeys mostly matches the captured terminal behavior, but non-ASCII
input is counted and positioned as UTF-16 code units instead of characters, contrary to
Non-ASCII printable input is accepted, but session and scoring logic use JavaScript
string length and indexed access. A single supplementary character such as an emoji
therefore advances the caret by two positions and is counted as two typed characters;
subsequent input is compared against the wrong target position. This breaks
per-character marking and scoring for input the specification explicitly allows.
i or a click to type · a apply · d diff · x discard
